_help: Organizations open to collaboration, shown as cards on Find Collaborators next to people. Organizations ask to be added through https://stemedplus.org/contact-us/. Required: name, summary, contact. lead: the lead person's name, shown under the name (the page asks organizations for it). logo: a file in site/ or an https address; leave it out to show initials. interests: short tags people can search and click; tags that start with "Offer:" or "Need:" show under "We can offer" and "We're looking for" and put the organization in the Offering and Looking for views (an organization with looking_for is in Looking for too).

organizations.name: STEMEd+ Commons
organizations.summary: Open to collaborations that strengthen the digital presence, infrastructure, and connectivity of STEM+ education communities.
organizations.looking_for: Societies, centers, networks, and research projects to partner on hosting groups and sites, open repositories and DOIs, and shared tools.
interests: Offer: hosting for groups and sites
